# 3. `src/domain/memory_session_store.ts`

- Status: added
- Role: session store implementation
- Assessment: Needs edits
- Anchor: `src/domain/memory_session_store.ts:8` (head side)
- Finding: `get()` returns `null` for a missing session, but the `SessionStore` contract
  (`src/domain/session.ts:16`) declares `Promise<Session>` and ships `SessionNotFound` for
  exactly this case. `tests/session_store.test.ts:15` expects the rejection, so the suite
  cannot pass against this implementation.
- Why it matters: the typed contract says a missing session is an error; returning `null`
  forces every consumer back onto a check the contract just removed.
- Evidence: static reading of the head contents; no tests executed in this workflow.
- Limits: `touch()` and `delete()` were read but not traced through callers outside the PR.
